original_text:
[Source PDF page 6]
(c) Construct an algorithm in pseudocode that outputs the maximum, minimum, and
average pollutant concentrations stored in the collection .
PLTNT
For example, using the data stored in the collection , the algorithm should output:
PLTNT
y Maximum pollutant concentration: 250
y Minimum pollutant concentration: 10
y Average pollutant concentration: 76.25 [9]
assessed_concepts: Construct: Construct an algorithm in pseudocode that outputs the maximum,minimum,and average pollutant concentrations stored in the collection PLTNT.

source_issues: SRC-025 PDF p15: Example 1 uses if/else-if extrema updates with sentinels and can miss the minimum in an increasing sequence; independent comparisons are required for that initialization. Integer DIV also gives the wrong fractional mean. The unofficial answer uses safe initialization, independent updates and true division.
